_about: House ontologies for harmonizing sample attribute values. Each entry names one ontology file in this folder: a JSON list of records with the keys TERM, DEF, ONT_SOURCE, ONT_ID and SYNONYMS. The files are the source of truth; nextseek_api/services/controlled_vocabularies.json (the upload-sheet dropdowns) is generated from the entries that name an upload_vocabulary. source_url plus an entry's file is that ontology's public link, for replies.

record_keys.TERM: The house spelling. A harmonized value equals it exactly.
record_keys.ONT_SOURCE: Where the term comes from: house, SRA, GEO, or an OBO ontology prefix (NCBITaxon, PATO, UBERON, MONDO, UO, EDAM).
record_keys.ONT_ID: The OBO id (for example NCBITaxon:10090) when ONT_SOURCE is an OBO ontology, else null.
record_keys.SYNONYMS: Other spellings known to mean exactly this term.

matching: Trim the stored value and collapse inner spaces. It matches a record when it equals the TERM or one of the SYNONYMS, compared case-insensitively unless the entry is case_sensitive. A value equal to the TERM exactly is already harmonized. No match means no term fits: never stretch one.
attributes_pattern: <sample type>.<attribute>; * matches any sample type, and *X any attribute ending in X.
